Workflow: find_and_take_object
When to use: when an object needs to be located and picked up from a receptacle or surface
Steps:
1. go to {receptacle} ({searching for the object})
2. take {object} from {receptacle} ({picking up the object})

Workflow: find_receptacle_and_open
When to use: when a receptacle needs to be opened to access its contents
Steps:
1. go to {receptacle} ({searching for the receptacle})
2. open {receptacle} ({opening the receptacle to access its contents})

Workflow: move_object_to_destination
When to use: when an object needs to be placed on a specific destination
Steps:
1. go to {destination} ({navigating to the destination})
2. move {object} to {destination} ({placing the object on the destination})

Workflow: navigate_and_inspect
When to use: when exploring different locations to gather information or find objects
Steps:
1. go to {location} ({moving to a specific location})
2. observe {location} ({checking the contents or state of the location})

Workflow: search_multiple_receptacles
When to use: when multiple receptacles need to be checked systematically for an object
Steps:
1. go to {receptacle} ({searching for the object})
2. open {receptacle} if closed ({accessing the contents})
3. repeat for next {receptacle} ({continuing the search})
<<<WORKFLOWS_END>>>
